description: The agent must: (1) Read teams/engineering/okrs/q3_2024_raw.json to understand the raw OKR data with null scores. (2) Consult SKILL.md to learn the Google-style 0.0–1.0 scoring scale with exact thresholds (Green: 0.7–1.0, Yellow: 0.4–0.6, Red: 0.0–0.3) and compute scores for all KRs based on final_value vs target. Qualitative KRs with no target must score 0.0. (3) Detect and flag the 'sandbagging' antipattern for Product Management team (all scores ≈ 0.9–1.0, well above the 60–70% sweet spot). (4) Flag the structural violation on Product Management team (6 Objectives, exceeding the 3-5 rule). (5) Flag the KR count violation on DML-O1 (7 Key Results, exceeding the 3-5 rule). (6) Flag qualitative/unmeasurable KRs (PE-O2-KR4, DML-O1-KR7, PM-O5-KR1 all have no measurable targets). (7) Compute Data & ML team's average score as very low (≤ 0.35) reflecting their catastrophic misses. (8) Include a retrospective section with lessons learned, coaching questions, and next-quarter recommendations per the end-of-quarter cadence format. (9) Include a division-level aggregate summary. (10) Save everything as q3_2024_retrospective.json. The key proprietary traps: the 0.0–1.0 scale (not percentage), the exact color thresholds, the 'sweet spot' sandbagging logic (100% is a red flag, not a success), and the 3-5 Objectives / 3-5 KRs structural rules.
